hero.title: Thread Quest
hero.lead: A closet and style tool. Save the clothes you like into your own closet, and build outfits from them.

sections.title: Where it's at
paragraphs: On the back burner since late 2024, after hitting a wall on affiliate marketing. In November 2026 I read every line of it again and wrote a rebuild plan.

facts.caption: 62 in 2024, built with Next.js and Google sign-in. Two in November 2026.
Save pieces you like, then build named outfits.

expanders.title: What I'm building
paragraphs: A closet and style tool. You collect pieces of clothing you like into your own closet and build your own outfits from them. Each piece opens on the store's site, so you buy it there. Collecting from any store, anywhere, is the focus for now.

artifacts.title: The rebuild plan
artifacts.text: Keep the name and the closet and outfit idea, and rebuild the rest on a tested backend.

artifacts.title: Outfits
artifacts.text: A closet page with saved pieces by category, and named outfits with a due date and a status.

expanders.title: What I tried
paragraphs: A catalog of men's clothing with filters, a closet you save pieces to, and named outfits built from it. I wired in an affiliate program to fund it.

artifacts.title: Affiliate tracking
artifacts.text: Several tries to get affiliate tracking working.

expanders.title: What didn't work
paragraphs: Affiliate marketing took several tries to wire up, then stalled waiting on approval. A catalog copied from stores goes stale.

artifacts.title: Affiliate links paused
artifacts.text: Paused until the affiliate program approves, and the project went to the back burner.

expanders.title: Open questions and next
paragraphs: Buying inside the app is an idea for later, because of the legal work it involves. Until then, each piece opens on the store's site. Other ideas, not plans yet: AI that gathers pieces you like into your closet, and a browser plugin that captures items while you shop.
